note:
R16 — Equipment (PS4 15–21): the DB selector → vault catalogue chain. For every equipment-shaped vault class (skater stick /
helmet / gloves / skates / visor / tape; goalie mask / stick / blocker / trapper / pads) the typed enum attributes and their value sets
(with the collection names and referenced texture paths per value), and for every selector field of `exhibitionskaterequipment` /
`exhibitiongoalieequipment` the DB value set; then the coverage of each DB selector by each enum type (≥ 95 % = candidate binding,
several candidates = ambiguous) and the reverse (catalogue values no player uses). Read-only.
Usage: python r16_equipment_chain.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21,...]
